title: The Household of God
sourceBasis: World English Bible — 66-book Old and New Testament Scripture text already installed in Iron Sharpener
definition: The household of God means that the church is God’s family, where believers belong to Him and to one another through Christ. The church is a family of faith marked by truth, care, honor, responsibility, and love.
summary: The household of God means that the church is God’s family, where believers belong to Him and to one another through Christ. The church is a family of faith marked by truth, care, honor, responsibility, and love.
christFocus: Jesus Christ brings sinners into the family of God. Through Him, believers are no longer strangers and outsiders, but members of God’s household with access to the Father.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
The church is described as the household of God. Believers are not merely attendees or religious customers; they are family members brought near through Christ.

This household is built on the foundation God has given and is held together in the Lord. Its life must be ordered by truth because the church is a pillar and support of the truth.

Family language brings both comfort and responsibility. Believers are called to care for one another, honor one another, carry burdens, practice hospitality, and do good especially to the household of faith.

This household does not replace every earthly family, but it gives believers a deeper family in Christ. Those rejected, lonely, or unsupported can find true belonging among God’s people.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Many people come from broken, unsafe, distant, or painful family backgrounds. The household of God gives a different picture of belonging: a redeemed family under the Father’s care and Christ’s lordship.

This doctrine also corrects casual church involvement. Family is not something to consume and discard when inconvenient. God calls His household to truth-shaped, patient, responsible love.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Live as part of God’s household. Welcome others, care for the weak, honor spiritual family, and help make the church a place of truth and Christlike love. If family pain has shaped your view of belonging, let the Father’s grace and Christ’s people teach you a better story.
